question.text: Under which regulations are Registrars to an Issue and Share Transfer Agents regulated?

answer.text: SEBI (Registrars to an Issue and Share Transfer Agents) Regulations, 1993

explanation.text: The Logic: Registrars to an Issue and Share Transfer Agents are persons registered under the SEBI (Registrars to an Issue and Share Transfer Agents) Regulations, 1993. They provide services relating to public or rights issues, including subscription data collation, basis of allotment, and crediting shares to allottees. The Trap: While these intermediaries interact with companies governed by the Companies Act, 2013 and with depositories under the Depositories Act, 1996, their registration and regulation falls specifically under the 1993 SEBI Regulations. The SC(R)A, 1956 governs stock exchanges and contracts, not RTA registration. Note: Stem reworded from "Under which act" to "Under which regulations" to align with the source — RTAs are regulated by SEBI Regulations, not by an Act.
